display_name: C01 Realized Warranty Cost vs Gross Submitted Claims

prompt.text: What is our total realized warranty cost compared to open reserve exposure and denied claims across all failure components?

golden_response.text: SELECT failure_component, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Approved' THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS realized_warranty_cost, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status IN ('Pending', 'Under Review') THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS open_reserve_exposure, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Denied' THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS denied_claim_amount FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` GROUP BY failure_component ORDER BY realized_warranty_cost DESC

property.description: Must filter claim_status = 'Approved' ($1,254,786.01 total) for realized warranty cost and separate 'Pending'/'Under Review' ($404,016.42) as open reserve exposure while excluding 'Denied' ($139,504.47).

sql_notes: Raw SUM(claim_amount) ($1,798,306.90) overstates realized warranty cost because it includes Pending, Under Review, and Denied claims.

display_name: C02 Net OEM Warranty Burden & Supplier Core-Return Leakage

prompt.text: Calculate our Recoverable Supplier Chargeback, Unrecovered Supplier Leakage from unreturned defective parts, and Net OEM Warranty Burden.

golden_response.text: WITH parts_by_order AS (  SELECT service_order_id, LOGICAL_AND(defective_part_returned) AS all_defective_parts_returned   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.service_parts_usage`   GROUP BY service_order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' THEN w.claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS realized_warranty_cost, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = TRUE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS recoverable_supplier_chargeback, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = FALSE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS unrecovered_supplier_leakage, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' THEN w.claim_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN w.claim_status = 'Approved' AND w.supplier_fault = TRUE AND COALESCE(p.all_defective_parts_returned, FALSE) = TRUE THEN w.claim_amount * 0.70 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS net_oem_warranty_burden FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` w LEFT JOIN parts_by_order p USING (service_order_id)

property.description: Must pre-aggregate service_parts_usage by service_order_id using LOGICAL_AND(defective_part_returned) to prevent 1.78x join fan-out, and apply 70% supplier recovery only on Approved supplier_fault=TRUE claims where all defective parts were returned.

sql_notes: Never join warranty_claims directly to service_parts_usage without pre-aggregating service_parts_usage to service_order_id grain.

display_name: C03 Total Dealership Service Cost Absorbed Under Warranty

prompt.text: How much total service order cost was absorbed by the OEM under warranty across our dealerships, broken down by service type?

golden_response.text: SELECT service_type, COUNT(*) AS covered_orders, ROUND(SUM(total_cost - customer_paid_amount), 2) AS oem_absorbed_warranty_cost FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.service_orders` WHERE is_warranty_covered = TRUE GROUP BY service_type ORDER BY oem_absorbed_warranty_cost DESC

property.description: Must filter WHERE is_warranty_covered = TRUE ($1,591,386.85 across 1,894 orders) rather than WHERE service_type = 'Warranty Repair' ($826,977.80), which misses 690 covered Repair orders and 282 covered Recall Service orders.

sql_notes: Use is_warranty_covered = TRUE to capture all 1,894 warranty-absorbed service visits ($1,591,386.85).

display_name: C04 Active Fleet Entitled to OEM Warranty Coverage

prompt.text: How many vehicles in our fleet are currently entitled to OEM warranty coverage under our secondary-market transfer rules?

golden_response.text: SELECT COUNTIF(warranty_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE() AND (ownership_status = 'Active' OR (ownership_status = 'Transferred' AND extended_warranty_purchased = TRUE))) AS active_warranty_entitled_fleet, COUNTIF(ownership_status = 'Active') AS active_original_owners, COUNTIF(ownership_status = 'Transferred' AND extended_warranty_purchased = TRUE) AS transferred_with_extended_warranty, COUNTIF(ownership_status = 'Transferred' AND extended_warranty_purchased = FALSE) AS transferred_unentitled_excluded, COUNTIF(ownership_status = 'Buyback') AS buyback_excluded FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.vehicle_ownership`

property.description: Must include Active vehicles (4,582) plus Transferred vehicles with extended_warranty_purchased = TRUE (68) for a total of 4,650 entitled vehicles, while excluding Buyback (114) and Transferred without extended warranty (236).

sql_notes: Standard warranty does not transfer on resale unless extended_warranty_purchased = TRUE.

display_name: C05 Active Manufacturing Plants vs 259-Row Catalog Padding

prompt.text: List our active manufacturing plants, their capacity, and their approved OEM assembly-fault warranty cost vs component-source supplier-fault cost.

golden_response.text: WITH active_plants AS (  SELECT DISTINCT p.plant_id, p.plant_name, p.location, p.capacity   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_manufacturing_data.plants` p   INNER JOIN `sa-demo-agentic.auto_manufacturing_data.assembly_line_status` als     ON p.plant_name = als.plant_name), assembly_claims AS (  SELECT build_plant_name AS plant_name,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Approved' AND supplier_fault = FALSE THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS assembly_fault_warranty_cost   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` GROUP BY build_plant_name), component_claims AS (  SELECT part_source_plant_name AS plant_name,   ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN claim_status = 'Approved' AND supplier_fault = TRUE THEN claim_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS component_fault_warranty_cost   FROM `sa-demo-agentic.auto_aftersales_data.warranty_claims` GROUP BY part_source_plant_name) SELECT ap.plant_id, ap.plant_name, ap.location, ap.capacity, COALESCE(ac.assembly_fault_warranty_cost, 0) AS assembly_fault_warranty_cost, COALESCE(cc.component_fault_warranty_cost, 0) AS component_fault_warranty_cost FROM active_plants ap LEFT JOIN assembly_claims ac USING (plant_name) LEFT JOIN component_claims cc USING (plant_name) ORDER BY assembly_fault_warranty_cost DESC

property.description: Must filter out the 252 padded placeholder rows in auto_manufacturing_data.plants by joining to assembly_line_status (leaving 7 active plants), and distinguish build_plant_name (assembly fault) from part_source_plant_name (supplier component fault).

sql_notes: plants, vehicle_models, and dealerships contain 259 rows where 251-252 rows are inactive ERP catalog padding.
